name: SubscriptionFlow Add-On for Paywall
author: appssf

sections.description:
SubscriptionFlow Add-On for Paywall is a powerful tool for managing content access restrictions based on user subscriptions. It provides an easy way to restrict access to articles, categories, tags, custom post types, and multimedia content such as PDFs, videos, and audio files.

Use this plugin to create customers, set paywall conditions, and control access to premium content using the SubscriptionFlow platform.

What is SubscriptionFlow

SubscriptionFlow is an all-inclusive subscription management software, powered by recurring billing & payment processing, pipeline management, customer churn reduction, and retention and revenue management tools, ensures unified, targeted, and automated subscription operations and draws revenue and happy customers, altogether.

  • Curate, Customize and Automate Subscription Lifecycles Read more
  • Streamline Billing and Payment Processes with Automation Read more
  • Multiply conversions with trial management solutions Read more
  • Pre-plan mitigation, limit churn, even retention & revenue Read more
  • Integrate Third-party Applications in One Platform Read more
  • Monitor Real-Time Analytics and Marketing Insights Read more

Features:
* Restrict content including articles, categories/tags, custom post types, PDFs, videos, and audio files.
* Customizable paywall settings for content restriction.
* Manage customer emails and settings directly within the plugin.
* Customize the restricted content message shown to non-subscribers.
* Add restriction conditions for any single WordPress user.
* Restrict content areas of a page or post using shortcodes.
* Support for payment gateways: Stripe, Authorize.net, PayPal, Braintree, and more.

External services

The plugin uses the SubscriptionFlow API to enable paywalls on WordPress blog posts, helping to manage subscriptions and restricted content efficiently.
sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin.
  2. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install it through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  3. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  4. Configure the plugin settings in the SubscriptionFlow settings page.
sections.faq:
How do I restrict content?

You can restrict content by using the provided shortcodes or by setting conditions in the plugin’s settings panel.

What payment gateways are supported?

The plugin supports Stripe, Authorize.net, PayPal, Braintree, and many others.
